note: Primary: Pearl Abyss on Xbox Wire, 'The Journey of Crimson Desert Continues with Charting the Unknown' (29 Oct 2026, read in full 23:12Z): Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown available 29 Oct (available now on Xbox Series X|S; Xbox on PC, Play Anywhere); three new storylines (Kliff, Oongka, Damiane); ocean exploration, diving, building and sailing a ship; deeper bonds that may lead to romance and marriage; housing built from the ground up; liberated castles become yours; lease and run a restaurant or smithy; Garden of Trials boss rush. Price USD 24.99 and 29 Oct from the Steam store page (story 2026-10-21, verified then); PS5 out now per outlets (Push Square 22:00Z). Footage: Pearl Abyss DLC reveal trailer (State of Play, 3 Sep), IGN official 3840 MP4, decode clean; the end slate with the old 15 Oct date is not used; the white flash at 71.5 to 72.8 is skipped. Sound: the trailer's music from 44.0 s; its narration ends at 43.6 s. pace_ok: shots are trailer stretches with their own cuts (44.05-49.65 cuts at 46.2, 48.2; 72.9-77.3 underwater moves).
